book_name: 中国钝颚白蚁 Ahmaditermes sinensis
distribution: 西藏墨脱亚禳，海拔一千米；背跚，海拔八百米。
en: Only the small soldier is described. It is paler than the large soldier and similar in build, but its head is smaller and narrower, and the antennae comprise 12 segments. No account of the large soldier, the alate or the worker is preserved in the source. The species is recorded from Medog in Tibet, at two stations about 800 and 1000 m above sea level.
soldier: 小兵蚁体色较大兵蚁为浅，体形相仿，而头较小且窄，触角十二节。
